## Adding a plugin or theme to the registry

- [ ] My entry is appended to the END of the JSON array
- [ ] `id` (plugins) / `name` (themes) is unique in the registry
- [ ] My repo has a `README.md`, a `LICENSE`, and `manifest.json` at the root
- [ ] I've created a GitHub release whose tag exactly equals my manifest version, with the release assets attached (`main.js` + `manifest.json` [+ `styles.css`] for plugins; `manifest.json` + `theme.css` for themes)
- [ ] I've read and my submission complies with `plugin-review.md`
